stories.title: Uncertainty hangs over U.S.-Iran talks as ceasefire deadline looms
stories.summary: President Trump says he does not want to extend the ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran as the clock ticks down on the deadline.

stories.title: Trump's pick to lead the Fed says he'd like to see 'regime change' in its policies
stories.summary: President Trump's pick to lead the Federal Reserve went before a Senate committee today — but Kevin Warsh's confirmation could be held up by forces that are outside his control.

stories.title: Trump administration gives an update on its plans to overhaul air traffic control
stories.summary: Nearly a year after launching an ambitious plan to rebuild the U.S.'s air traffic control infrastructure, leaders at the DOT gave an update, including details on a proposed AI-driven software system.

stories.title: What the sudden turnover in Trump's Cabinet means for him politically
stories.summary: With the news that Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer would be leaving her post later this year, President Trump has lost three high-profile women on his Cabinet in a little over a month.

stories.title: An unusual number of Congress members are being pressured to resign or face expulsion
stories.summary: Rep. Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick, D-Fla., is one of four House members who have been under pressure to resign or face expulsion recently. What does this spate of embattled members say about Congress?

stories.title: Instead of civil war, a naked mole rat colony changed queens peacefully
stories.summary: These matriarchal rodents often have  bloody succession wars to replace their queen. But in a colony in California, Queen Tere ceded the throne to her daughter, Arwen, without violence.
